# Salwa Ahmed Law

> Official website for Salwa Ahmed, a Saudi lawyer providing remote legal consultation and related legal services across Saudi Arabia.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://salwalaw.hositee.com/): General legal consultation and service overview.
- [Legal Consultation](https://salwalaw.hositee.com/استشارات-قانونية/): Initial legal consultation requests.
- [Contracts](https://salwalaw.hositee.com/محامي-عقود/): Contract review and contract-related legal consultation.
- [Labor Law](https://salwalaw.hositee.com/محامي-قضايا-عمالية/): Saudi labor-law related consultation and case review.
- [Personal Status](https://salwalaw.hositee.com/محامي-احوال-شخصية/): Personal-status legal consultation.
- [Intellectual Property](https://salwalaw.hositee.com/ملكية-فكرية/): Intellectual-property consultation and dispute-prevention guidance.
- [Privacy Policy](https://salwalaw.hositee.com/سياسة-الخصوصية/): Data collection and privacy information.

## Primary action

Each service page contains a structured legal-consultation request form. The form collects the requester's name, phone number, requested service, optional case summary, and consent to use the submitted data for follow-up. Successful submissions are acknowledged only after durable server-side storage.

## Contact

The website provides direct phone and WhatsApp contact options. Services are presented as remote services available across Saudi Arabia; no physical-office location is claimed on this website.

## Important notes

- Website content is informational and does not guarantee any legal outcome.
- Sending a form does not by itself mean a matter or case has been accepted.
- Government and professional entities shown on the website are displayed as relevant regulatory or professional references and do not imply partnership or additional endorsement.
